convert_dataset_to_hdf5: run the script to convert an ImageNet dataset into an HDF5 file for improved I/O performance
prepare_parser: create an argparse parser with arguments for resolution, split, data_root, out_path, longtail, batch_size, num_workers, chunk_size, and compression
run_hdf5_conversion: run the dataset conversion pipeline that loads images via a dataloader and writes them chunked into an HDF5 file
configure_hdf5_chunking: run the script with a custom chunk_size argument to tune HDF5 read/write performance for your hardware
compress_hdf5_dataset: run the script with the compression flag to enable LZF compression on the output HDF5 file
